    def log_recipe(self):
        """
        Select a recipe, log to Breakfast, and assert recipe name and calories match:
        1. Get text from RECIPE_NAME and RECIPE_CALORIES (recipe detail page).
        2. Click 'Log Recipe', select 'Breakfast', capture calories from log panel.
        3. Save and view logs.
        4. Get text from RECIPE_NAME_TEXT and RECIPE_CALORIES_CONFIRM (logs page).
        5. Assert name and calories match across all steps.
        """
        def normalize_calories(text: str) -> str:
            return text.replace(" ", "").strip()
    
        # Get recipe name and calories before logging
        recipe_name = self.page.locator(self.RECIPE_NAME).inner_text()
        calories = normalize_calories(self.page.locator(self.RECIPE_CALORIES).first.inner_text())
    
        self.page.locator(self.LOG_RECIPE_BUTTON).click()
        self.page.locator(self.BREAKFAST_BUTTON).click()
        calories_log = normalize_calories(self.page.locator(self.RECIPE_CALORIES_LOG).inner_text())
        self.page.locator(self.LOG_RECIPE_CONFIRM).click()
        self.page.locator(self.VIEW_LOGS_BUTTON).click()
    
        # Get recipe name and calories after logging — filter by recipe_name to match the correct card
        recipe_name_text = self.page.locator(self.RECIPE_NAME_TEXT).last.inner_text()
        calories_confirm = normalize_calories(self.page.locator(self.RECIPE_CALORIES_CONFIRM).last.inner_text())
        # Assert recipe name matches
